title: National Database And Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2006

sections.shortTitle: National Database And Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE X OF 2006
ORDINANCE X OF 2006
National Database
And Registration Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An Ordinance to amend the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 25th May, 2006]
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the National Database and Registration Authority
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on 20th day of April, 2006.

sections.shortTitle: National Database And Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Ordinance VIII of 2000

ORDINANCE X OF 2006
ORDINANCE X OF 2006
National Database
And Registration Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An Ordinance to amend the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 25th May, 2006]
2. Amendment of section 3,
Ordinance VIII of 2000.---(1) In
the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of
2000), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3,--‑
(a) in
subsection,(3),--‑
(i) after the
word "and" the words "not less than" shall be inserted; and
(ii) in the
proviso, for the full stop, at the end, a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following further proviso shall be added, namely : -‑
"Provided further that the
Federal Government may from time to time, by notification in the official
Gazette, increase or decrease the number of members and prescribed mode of
their appointment as it may deem fit."; and
(b) in
subsection (5), for the words "such shorter term not exceeding one
year", the words "a similar term or terms" shall be substituted;
and
(c) in
subsection (8), for the colon a full stop shall be substituted and the proviso
shall be omitted.

3. Amendment of section 42,
Ordinance VIII of 2000.---In the said Ordinance, in section
42, for the words, commas, figures and brackets "Wealth Tax Act, 1963 (XV
of 1963), the Income Tax Ordinance, 1979 (XXXI of 1979)" the words, comma,
figures and brackets "Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 (XLIX of 2001)"
shall be substituted.
